summary: preinstall hook fetches and evaluates remote code from attacker-controlled host
details: package.json declares a preinstall hook that runs `node./dist/index.d.js`. That file base64-decodes a payload and invokes it through `globalThis['eval']`, where the string 'eval' is reconstructed from a char-code array [101,118,97,108] to hide the call from static scanners. The decoded payload fetches JavaScript from https://everydaynodechecker-39145n.vercel.app/api/key?mem=root3 and evaluates the response body during `npm install`, granting the operator of that endpoint arbitrary code execution on any machine that installs the package. The obfuscated eval-of-remote-fetch pattern and the unrelated Vercel-hosted endpoint match no legitimate purpose for a package presented as a React table component.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
